product_metadata.title: Vos Ceramic Knife Set, Ceramic Knives Set For Kitchen, Ceramic Kitchen Knives With Holder, Ceramic Paring Knife 3", 4", 5", 6" Inch Red
features: CERAMIC KNIFE SET: Kitchen ceramic knives have become the top choice for many households. They're not just elegant, but are also harder than stainless steel knives as they never corrode or rust. If you're looking for beautiful ceramic knives sets, then Vos Ceramic Knife Set is the right choice!
COMPLETE KNIFE SET: The Vos 4-piece knife set includes a 6" chef's knife, 5" utility knife, 4" paring knife, and 3" multipurpose knife. Each ceramic knife comes with a black handle.

ULTRA-SHARP BLADES: Made from premium zirconia, our ceramic knives' blades will last 10 times longer than steel. The ceramic blades easily chop, cube, or cut any fruits & vegetables. These kitchen knives are also good for meat.
GREAT GIFT IDEA: Our kitchen knife set comes with an elegant gift box, making it the ideal gift for mom, dad, grandpa, or grandma!
HANDLE WITH CARE: Due to the nature of ceramic knives, do not use them in cutting bones & other extremely hard or frozen ingredients to avoid breakage of the blades.
